rule.name: SpringWriteAfterCommitDropped
rule.message: Move this write into a new transaction, @Transactional(propagation = Propagation.REQUIRES_NEW) on the listener, or listen with phase = TransactionPhase.BEFORE_COMMIT: an after-commit @TransactionalEventListener still joins the finished transaction, so the write is never committed and no error is raised.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodDeclaration [ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.event.TransactionalEventListener')] [not(AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'phase']//*[@Name = 'BEFORE_COMMIT'])]] [not(ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional')][AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'propagation']//*[@Name = ('REQUIRES_NEW', 'NOT_SUPPORTED')]])] [ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional')] or not(ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1]/ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional')][AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'propagation']//*[@Name = ('REQUIRES_NEW', 'NOT_SUPPORTED')]])] [not(ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Async')])] [not(ancestor::ClassDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Async')]])] /Block//MethodCall[not(ancestor::LambdaExpression or ancestor::AnonymousClassDeclaration)] [(*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository')] and matches(@MethodName, '^(save|delete|insert|update|remove)([A-Z0-9_]|$)')) or (*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.EntityManager') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.EntityManager')] and @MethodName = ('persist', 'merge', 'remove')) or (*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcOperations') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.jdbc.core.namedparam.NamedParameterJdbcOperations')] and @MethodName = ('update', 'batchUpdate'))]
